This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |

| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt

- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

1	# RequestKv：一个请求的 KV 生命周期
2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	上一讲（u2-l1）我们认识了 `BlockPool`——它把物理页的发放、共享与回收管了起来，但一直没回答：**一个具体请求的 KV 到底是怎么一步步走完一生的？** 本讲就沿着 `RequestKv` 这条主线，把答案补全。学完后你应该能够：
6	
7	1. 完整复述一个请求从 `new_request` 到 `release` 的 KV 状态变迁：预填（prefill）→ 解码（decode）循环 → 释放，以及投机解码（speculative）这条变体路径。
8	2. 解释 **schedule（调度）与 apply（应用）两阶段分离** 的设计：为什么「预约块」和「提交结果」必须是两个动作，以及它带来的失败恢复能力（`revert_schedule`、drop 守卫）。
9	3. 理解视图族的三条不变式：`decode_view` 的 `seq_len == kv_position + 1`、`prefill_view` 覆盖目标长度、页表行必须**精确覆盖**序列长度。
10	4. 熟练使用状态查询族（`kv_position` / `generated_tokens` / `is_complete` / `resident_blocks`）推断任意时刻的池容量变化。
11	
12	## 2. 前置知识
13	
14	本讲假设你已读过 u1-l3（页几何）与 u2-l1（BlockPool 与 padding 块）。在此之上，只需要再补三个推理引擎的常识：
15	
16	- **预填（prefill）**：把 prompt 的所有 token 一次（或分块）喂进模型，计算出它们的 K/V 并写入缓存。这是「读题」阶段，计算量大但只做一次。
17	- **解码（decode）**：预填产出第一个生成 token 之后，每一步只把**一个**新 token 喂进模型，算出它的 K/V，再采样出下一个 token。这是「答题」阶段，一步一个 token。
18	- **悬空 token（dangling token）**：每次 forward 刚采样出来的那个 token，它的 K/V **还没有**被计算——它要等到下一步 forward 时才作为输入被算进缓存。`tests/lifecycle.rs` 的注释里有原话："token 42 is 'dangling' (not yet in KV)"。理解「悬空」是理解 `decode_view` 为什么是 `kv_position + 1` 的关键。
19	- **投机解码（speculative decode，选读）**：先让一个小模型连猜 `k` 个候选 token，再让大模型一次 forward 同时验证这 `k` 个位置，接受猜对的前缀。KV 层面表现为「一次预约多个位置的块，但只提交被接受的部分」。
20	
21	另外回顾两个上一讲的结论，本讲会反复用到：
22	
23	- 池构造时预留 1 块做 CUDA Graph 的 padding 槽，所以 `available_blocks() == total_blocks() - 1`。
24	- `BlockPool` 只发放**块 ID**，不持有显存；「拿了几块」完全可以从 `available_blocks()` 的变化观察出来——这正是本讲实践任务的观察窗口。

38	## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解
39	
40	先给一张总路线图。`RequestKv` 的结构体文档把生命周期写成了一行协议（原文见 [src/pool.rs:L373-L378](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L373-L378)）：
41	
42	```
43	new_request
44	    │
45	    ▼
46	schedule_prefill(n) → prefill_view(n) → [forward] → apply_prefill / apply_prefill_chunk
47	    │                                                            │
48	    │            ←── 失败：revert_schedule 撤销预约，或直接 drop ──┘
49	    ▼
50	┌─ 解码循环（每轮一个 token）──────────────────────────────────────┐
51	│   schedule_decode → decode_view → [forward] → apply_decode      │
52	│   （或投机支线：schedule_speculative(k) → speculative_view(k)    │
53	│     → [forward] → apply_speculative(accepted)；失败 revert）     │
54	└──────────────────────────── is_complete() ──────────────────────┘
55	    │
56	    ▼
57	release()（或直接 drop）→ 块回到池
58	```
59	
60	每个 forward 步骤内部都遵循同一个三拍子节奏：**预约（schedule）→ 给内核看视图（view）→ 提交（apply）**。下面四个小节依次拆解这三个拍子加一个「观察窗口」。
61	
62	### 4.1 调度族：schedule_prefill / schedule_decode / schedule_speculative 与 ScheduleError
63	
64	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
65	
66	「调度」= **为这一步 forward 要写入的 KV 预约物理块**。它只动块、不动状态：预约成功后 `kv_position` 不变、没有任何 token 被认定已算完——计算要等 forward 真正跑完，由 apply 来承认。
67	
68	为什么要单独一拍「预约」？因为块是稀缺资源，必须**先谈好再干活**：
69	
70	- 准入判断需要它：池不够时这一步直接失败，GPU 白跑之前就能拒绝（测试 `exhaust_capacity_returns_error` 演示的正是这个）。
71	- 失败恢复需要它：forward 可能在预约之后、提交之前失败（CUDA 错误、请求被取消）。预约与提交分离后，「已预约未提交」是一个明确的状态，可以精确撤销（`revert_schedule`），甚至什么都不做、直接 drop 也能靠析构守卫把块还回去。
72	
73	三个调度入口对应三种 forward 形状：
74	
75	| 入口 | 一步写入的 KV | 典型预约量 |
76	|------|--------------|-----------|
77	| `schedule_prefill(num_tokens)` | 预填的一 chunk（可达上千 token） | \(\lceil \text{num\_tokens} / \text{block\_size} \rceil\) 块 |
78	| `schedule_decode` | 1 个 token（当前的悬空 token） | 通常 0 块（塞进现有块）；恰好填满最后一块时会**多**预约下一块 |
79	| `schedule_speculative(k)` | k 个连续位置（悬空 token + 候选草稿） | 覆盖这 k 个位置所需的块 |
80	
81	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
82	
83	```
84	schedule_*(参数, pool):
85	    1. 检查请求状态机是否允许（必须处于 Idle/可调度态）
86	    2. 计算本步新增 KV 需要多少块
87	    3. 向 block_manager 申请块
88	       ├─ 成功：请求进入「已预约未提交」态，返回 Ok(())
89	       └─ 不够：返回 Err(ScheduleError::AllocationFailed { needed })
90	                  ——此时一块都没拿到，请求什么也不持有
91	```
92	
93	失败分类由上游 `ScheduleError` 承载，共七种（见 4.1.3 的表）。

95	#### 4.1.3 源码精读
96	
97	三个调度方法本体极薄，全部转调上游（[src/pool.rs:L450-L473](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L450-L473)）：

101	    &mut self,
102	    num_tokens: usize,
103	    pool: &BlockPool,
104	) -> Result<(), ScheduleError> {
105	    self.seq.schedule_prefill(num_tokens, &pool.block_manager)
106	}
107	
108	pub fn schedule_decode(&mut self, pool: &BlockPool) -> Result<(), ScheduleError> {
109	    self.seq.schedule_decode(&pool.block_manager)
110	}
111	
112	pub fn schedule_speculative(
113	    &mut self,
114	    num_draft_tokens: usize,
115	    pool: &BlockPool,

117	    self.seq

119	}
120	```
121	
122	这段代码做的事：把「本步要写多少 token 的 KV」连同池的底层 `block_manager` 交给上游 `SchedulableSequence`，由它完成状态检查与块申请。注意三类调度的语义差别写在文档注释里——`schedule_speculative` 的注释明确「覆盖 `num_draft_tokens` 个连续位置（当前悬空 token + 候选草稿），失败用 `revert_schedule` 归还」。

188	### 4.2 视图族：prefill_view / decode_view / speculative_view
189	
190	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
191	
192	预约好了块，forward 之前还要回答注意力内核的两个问题：**这个请求的 KV 分布在哪几页？序列现在多长？** 这就是视图族的职责——把事务层（块、位置）翻译成内核只读的 `KvView`（三个字段：页表行、`seq_len`、`page_size`，见 [src/view.rs:L12-L16](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/view.rs#L12-L16)）。
193	
194	两个不变式是这一族的灵魂：
195	
196	1. **seq_len 是「本步之后」的长度**。视图描述的不是当前状态，而是「这一步 forward 写入完成后，内核将看到的 KV 全貌」。文档原话：*"The view's seq_len = kv_position + prompt_len (post-advance state that FlashInfer attention metadata expects)"*（[src/pool.rs:L480-L483](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L480-L483)）。于是：
197	   - `decode_view()`：\( \text{seq\_len} = \text{kv\_position} + 1 \)（现有 KV + 悬空 token 这一步将要写入的那条）；
198	   - `prefill_view(prompt_len)`：\( \text{seq\_len} = \text{kv\_position} + \text{prompt\_len} \)——**覆盖目标长度**，支持从非零位置续算的分块预填；
199	   - `speculative_view(k)`：\( \text{seq\_len} = \text{kv\_position} + k \)。
200	2. **页表行必须精确覆盖 seq_len**。内核按 \( \text{seq\_len} = (\text{num\_pages}-1) \times \text{page\_size} + \text{last\_page\_len} \) 反推长度：多给一页，内核会**多读一段序列之外的垃圾 K/V**；少给一页则越界（`KvView::new` 的断言注释原文引用了 issue #291，[src/view.rs:L19-L27](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/view.rs#L19-L27)）。
201	
202	精确性之所以要专门 defended，是因为**原始块列表不可信**：kvbm 的 `schedule_decode` 有「积极分配」行为——当本步 token 恰好填满当前最后一块时，会顺手把下一块也分配了。于是 `page_indices()`（原始持有列表）可以比实际 KV 需要多一块。直接把原始列表给内核 = 让内核看到更长的序列 = 读垃圾页。

212	step_page_indices(new_tokens):
213	    assert new_tokens > 0
214	    kv_tokens = kv_position + new_tokens

300	### 4.3 提交族：apply_prefill / apply_prefill_chunk / apply_decode / apply_speculative、revert_schedule 与 release
301	
302	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
303	
304	forward 跑完、新 KV 已落在预约的页里，提交族负责让**事务层承认这次计算**，一次 apply 做三件事：
305	
306	1. 把本步写满的块**封块注册**（注册过的块从此可被前缀缓存复用——上一讲「释放的注册块进 LRU 非活跃池」的伏笔在这里接上）；
307	2. 推进 `kv_position`；
308	3. 登记新采样的 token（它成为新的悬空 token），`generated_tokens` 加一。
309	
310	提交族的五个成员各管一种收尾：
311	
312	| 方法 | 场景 | 关键语义 |
313	|------|------|---------|
314	| `apply_prefill(token, pool)` | **最后一个**预填 chunk | 收下本步产出的第一个生成 token；此后进入解码态 |
315	| `apply_prefill_chunk(pool)` | 非最后的预填 chunk | 只封块、推进 `kv_position`，**不**产出 token（文档明确：最后一块必须走 `apply_prefill`） |
316	| `apply_decode(token, pool)` | 解码一步 | 返回 `DecodeOutcome`，告知块边界/长度上限是否到达 |
317	| `apply_speculative(accepted, pool)` | 投机验证步 | 只提交**被接受**的前缀，拒绝的草稿块按 LIFO 归还 |
318	| `release()` / `drop` | 请求终结 | 全部块归还：注册块进非活跃池（可复用），未注册块回空闲池 |
319	
320	`DecodeOutcome` 是 `apply_decode` / `apply_speculative` 的返回值（[kvbm/kvbm-logical/src/integrations/scheduled.rs:L183-L188](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/kvbm/kvbm-logical/src/integrations/scheduled.rs#L183-L188)），四个变体可两两组合：
321	
322	```rust
323	pub enum DecodeOutcome {
324	    Continue,
325	    BlockCompleted,
326	    MaxLength,
327	    BlockCompletedAndMaxLength,
328	}
329	```
330	
331	从命名即可读出语义：「这一步是否恰好封满一块」（`BlockCompleted`，提示调度器该块已可复用）与「生成是否已达 `max_output_tokens`」（`MaxLength`，请求完成），两者同时发生就是第四个变体。
332	
333	两阶段分离的**失败恢复面**由两个出口兜底：`revert_schedule` 主动撤销「已预约未提交」的一步（文档举例：投机的 forward 或 apply 失败时）；什么都不做直接 drop 则由 `SchedulableSequence` 的析构守卫归还——测试 `schedule_without_apply_returns_blocks_on_drop` 的注释就是这个行为的规格说明（*"dropping RequestKv must return those blocks to the pool"*，[tests/lifecycle.rs:L171-L192](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L171-L192)）。

335	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
336	
337	```
338	apply_prefill(token):
339	    校验状态 == 已调度的最终预填 chunk
340	    封块注册本 chunk 的页 → kv_position += chunk_len
341	    记录 token 为悬空 token，generated_tokens += 1     # 第一个生成 token
342	
343	apply_decode(token):
344	    封块/推进 kv_position（把上一个悬空 token 的 KV 落账）
345	    记录新 token 为悬空 token，generated_tokens += 1
346	    返回 Continue | BlockCompleted | MaxLength | BlockCompletedAndMaxLength
347	
348	apply_speculative(accepted_tokens):
349	    只保留 accepted 前缀对应的 KV；被拒草稿块 LIFO 归还
350	    generated_tokens += accepted.len()
351	
352	失败出口 A：revert_schedule()   → 撤销本步预约，请求存活，可继续
353	失败出口 B：直接 drop            → 析构守卫归还本步预约的块
354	终结：     release()            → 归还全部块（注册块 → 非活跃池，可被前缀缓存命中）
355	```

413	这段测试做的事：32-token 预填预约 2 块（可用 9 → 7），在内层作用域结束时**故意不 apply 就 drop**，出作用域后可用块数必须回到 9。引擎由此获得一条免费的安全网：forward 崩了、请求被取消、上层代码 panic 展开——只要 `RequestKv` 被析构，块就不会泄漏。

415	端到端全流程的黄金样例是 `single_request_prefill_decode_release`（[tests/lifecycle.rs:L10-L50](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L10-L50)），它把 4.1-4.4 四族 API 按协议顺序各用一遍，综合实践一节会逐行排演它。
416	
417	#### 4.3.4 代码实践
418	
419	1. **实践目标**：预测 `single_request_prefill_decode_release` 中六次提交的返回值（尤其 `DecodeOutcome`）。
420	2. **操作步骤**：
421	   - 场景：prompt 10 个 token，`max_output_tokens = 6`；`block_size = 16`。`apply_prefill(42)` 之后 `kv_position = 10`、`generated = 1`；解码循环执行 5 次 `apply_decode(100 + i)`，`kv_position` 走 11→15，始终没有跨过 16 的块边界。
422	   - 先在纸上写下每次 `apply_decode` 的预期 `DecodeOutcome`，再在**你自己的克隆**里把测试复制一份，将 `let _ = req.apply_decode(...)` 改成收集返回值并 `println!("{:?}", outcome)`。
423	3. **需要观察的现象**：前几次与最后一次的变体不同。
424	4. **预期结果**：按变体命名语义推断应为 4 次 `Continue` + 最后一次 `MaxLength`（生成数到达上限 6；全程未封满块，故无 `BlockCompleted`）。此为**基于变体命名的推断，待本地验证**。
425	
426	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
427	
428	**练习 1**：`apply_prefill` 有 `token` 参数而 `apply_prefill_chunk` 没有，为什么？
429	
430	答案：只有**最终**预填 chunk 会触发采样、产出第一个生成 token（要把它登记为悬空 token）；中间 chunk 只封块推进位置，没有 token 可交。上游用 `Some(token)` / `None` 区分（[src/pool.rs:L519-L532](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L519-L532)）。
431	
432	**练习 2**：`revert_schedule` 和 `release` 都把块还给池，差别是什么？
433	
434	答案：`revert_schedule` 只撤销**当前这一步已预约未提交**的预约，请求继续存活、状态回到可再次调度（用于一步失败后的重试）；`release` 终结整个请求，归还其**全部**块——其中注册过的块进入非活跃池成为前缀缓存的一部分，而非简单回空闲池（[src/pool.rs:L552-L564](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L552-L564)，非活跃池语义见 u2-l1）。
435	
436	**练习 3**：`apply_speculative` 为什么必须 LIFO 归还被拒的草稿块？
437	
438	答案：投机一步预约的是覆盖 k 个连续位置的一串块，验证后只有被接受前缀的 KV 要保留。被拒部分集中在预约串的**尾部**，后进先出的归还顺序恰好对应「从尾部往回收」，使保留前缀与已注册块的边界保持一致，避免误放仍被接受的块（文档注释：*"kvbm keeps the `accepted_tokens` KV and LIFO-releases the rejected draft blocks"*，[src/pool.rs:L540-L550](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L540-L550)；完整语义在上游 kvbm，**深入实现待确认**）。
439	
440	### 4.4 状态查询族：kv_position / generated_tokens / is_complete / resident_blocks
441	
442	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
443	
444	调度器每一步都要「看一眼」请求才能决策，查询族就是这扇观察窗。四个量各数一件事，**初学者最容易混的是前三个**：
445	
446	| 查询 | 数的是什么 | 单调性 |
447	|------|-----------|--------|
448	| `kv_position()` | K/V **已算完落账**的 token 数（悬空 token 不算） | 只增 |
449	| `generated_tokens()` | 已产出的生成 token 数（含悬空的那颗） | 只增 |
450	| `is_complete()` | 生成是否已达 `max_output_tokens` | 一旦真不再变 |
451	| `resident_blocks()` | 此刻**物理上**持有的块数（注册 + 已 stage + 未指派） | 可升可降（apply/revert/释放） |
452	
453	`kv_position` 与 `generated_tokens` 永远差 1（预填完成后）：产出的最新 token 悬空着，等下一步才算 KV。这就是「视图 = `kv_position` + 1」的代数根源。
454	
455	`resident_blocks` 是四个里唯一**可以暂时超过** \(\lceil \text{kv\_position} / \text{block\_size} \rceil\) 的量——因为积极分配的块、预约未提交的块都真实占着物理页。文档原话：*"Physical blocks currently held by this request, including registered, staged, and eagerly allocated dangling blocks"*（[src/pool.rs:L592-L596](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L592-L596)）。调度器做准入时必须用它（而非 `kv_position` 推算），否则会低估占用。
456	
457	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
458	
459	```
460	任意时刻：
461	    kv_position       = 已封块/已落账的 KV token 数
462	    generated_tokens  = kv_position - prompt_len + 1        （预填完成后）
463	    is_complete()     ⇔ generated_tokens ≥ max_output_tokens
464	    resident_blocks   = assigned + staged + unassigned      ≥ ceil(kv_position / block_size)
465	
466	available_blocks()    = 池总块数 - 1(padding) - Σ各请求 resident_blocks（近似，忽略非活跃池回收的细节）
467	```
468	
469	（最后一个式子是理解综合实践里容量排演的钥匙：**观察一个请求的占用，就看 `available_blocks` 掉了多少**。）
470	
471	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
472	
473	查询族一览（[src/pool.rs:L577-L596](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L577-L596)）：
474	
475	```rust
476	/// Tokens with KV already computed.
477	pub fn kv_position(&self) -> usize {
478	    self.seq.kv_position()
479	}
480	
481	pub fn generated_tokens(&self) -> usize {
482	    self.seq.generated_tokens()
483	}
484	
485	/// Physical blocks currently held by this request, including registered,
486	/// staged, and eagerly allocated dangling blocks.
487	pub fn resident_blocks(&self) -> usize {
488	    self.seq.assigned_blocks() + self.seq.staged_blocks() + self.seq.unassigned_blocks()
489	}
490	```
491	
492	这段代码做的事：三个计数直接读上游序列；`resident_blocks` 明确把三类持有（已注册 / 已 stage / 未指派）加总——其中「未指派」就包含积极分配出的下一块。
493	
494	与视图族衔接的两个页表查询也值得认识（[src/pool.rs:L598-L631](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L598-L631)）：`page_indices()` 是**原始**持有列表（可以多一块，私有方法）；`current_page_indices()` 把它截断到当前 `kv_position` 需要的页数，供 offload 等模块做「现在已落账的页」的快照；`step_page_indices(n)` 是 forward 用的精确页表行（4.2 已精读）。三者同名异义，正是「原始 vs 落账 vs 本步」三个视角的代码化。
495	
496	测试侧的对应断言：`single_request_prefill_decode_release` 在预填 apply 后立刻断言 `kv_position() == 10`、`generated_tokens() == 1`（[tests/lifecycle.rs:L31-L33](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L31-L33)），解码五轮后断言 `generated_tokens() == 6` 且 `is_complete()`（[tests/lifecycle.rs:L44-L45](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L44-L45)）——注意 `is_complete` 为真时**最后那颗 token 仍是悬空的**，`kv_position` 停在 15 而非 16。
497	
498	#### 4.4.4 代码实践
499	
500	1. **实践目标**：用查询族给 `single_request_prefill_decode_release` 建一张状态时间线表。
501	2. **操作步骤**：对照 [tests/lifecycle.rs:L10-L50](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L10-L50)，为下表的每个空格填值（`block_size = 16`，prompt 10，max 输出 6）：
502	
503	   | 时刻 | kv_position | generated_tokens | is_complete | resident_blocks |
504	   |------|-------------|------------------|-------------|-----------------|
505	   | new_request 后 | 0 | 0 | 否 | 0 |
506	   | schedule_prefill(10) 后 | ？ | 0 | 否 | ？ |
507	   | apply_prefill(42) 后 | 10 | ？ | 否 | ？ |
508	   | 第 2 次 apply_decode 后 | ？ | 3 | 否 | ？ |
509	   | 第 5 次 apply_decode 后 | 15 | ？ | ？ | ？ |
510	
511	3. **需要观察的现象**：`resident_blocks` 一列前两行就能确定（预约 1 块），后几行因积极分配时机依赖上游实现，标注「待确认」。
512	4. **预期结果**：填完后与 4.4.5 练习 1 的答案对照；如本地有环境，可复制测试加打印核实 `resident_blocks` 列（**待本地验证**）。
513	
514	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
515	
516	**练习 1**：给出上表的完整答案。
517	
518	答案：schedule_prefill(10) 后 `kv_position = 0`（调度不动位置）、`resident_blocks = 1`；apply_prefill(42) 后 `generated_tokens = 1`、`resident_blocks = 1`（10 个 token 一块装得下；42 悬空不占 KV）；第 2 次 apply_decode 后 `kv_position = 12`（10 + 42 + 100 两颗已落账）；第 5 次 apply_decode 后 `generated_tokens = 6`、`is_complete = true`、`kv_position = 15`（第 6 颗生成 token 悬空，永不算 KV）、`resident_blocks` 大概率仍为 1（未触块边界，是否发生积极分配**待确认**）。
519	
520	**练习 2**：预填完成后，`kv_position` 与 `generated_tokens` 恒差 1，这个 1 是什么？
521	
522	答案：就是悬空 token——刚采样出来、KV 尚未计算的那颗。它是下一步 forward 的输入；若请求就此完成（如上题），它永远悬空，这也是「16 prompt + 16 输出只需 \(\lceil 31/16 \rceil = 2\) 块」里那个「-1」的来源。
523	
524	**练习 3**：调度器准入一个新请求时，为什么不该用 \(\lceil \text{kv\_position} / \text{block\_size} \rceil\) 估算在场请求的占用？
525	
526	答案：那是「已落账」的页数下界；真实占用还包括积极分配的未指派块、已预约未提交的块。`resident_blocks()` 把三类全部加总（[src/pool.rs:L594-L596](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L594-L596)），用它才不会超发。
527	
528	## 5. 综合实践
529	
530	把整讲串起来的任务：**给两个生命周期测试写出 `available_blocks()` 的逐行剧本，再用一个无 GPU 的纯逻辑测试验证 drop 守卫**。
531	
532	**第一步：排演 `single_request_prefill_decode_release`**（[tests/lifecycle.rs:L10-L50](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L10-L50)，池 32 块）。逐行写可用块数并注明依据：
533	
534	| 步骤 | available_blocks | 依据 |
535	|------|------------------|------|
536	| 构造后 | 31 | 32 − 1 padding（测试断言） |
537	| new_request([1;10], 6) | 31 | 只建序列，不占块 |
538	| schedule_prefill(10) | 30 | \(\lceil 10/16 \rceil = 1\) 块 |
539	| prefill_view(10) | 30 | 视图只读 |
540	| apply_prefill(42) | 30 | 块早在预约时扣过 |
541	| 5 × (schedule_decode + apply_decode) | 30 左右 | 不跨 16 边界时基本不再拿块；某步若触发积极分配会再 −1（**待本地验证**） |
542	| release() | 31 | 测试断言回到 initial_avail |

544	**第二步：排演 `multiple_requests_share_capacity`**（[tests/lifecycle.rs:L52-L79](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L52-L79)，池 10 块）。测试只断言了三处硬值（初始 9、`after_a < 9`、`after_b < after_a`、双释放后回到 9），请把每一处 `<` 换成你预测的精确值，并注明哪些数字依赖积极分配时机（**待本地验证**）。
545	
546	**第三步：验证 drop 守卫（无 GPU）**。模仿 4.1.4 的纯逻辑写法，把 [tests/lifecycle.rs:L173-L192](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L173-L192) 改写成 `BlockPool::new(16, 10)` 版本（下面是**示例代码**）：

548	```rust

550

559	        // 故意不 apply —— 模拟 forward 失败，出作用域直接 drop

566	
567	## 6. 本讲小结
568	
569	- 一个 forward 步骤固定三拍：**schedule（预约块）→ view（给内核精确页表）→ apply（封块、推进 `kv_position`、登记新悬空 token）**；`RequestKv` 是上游 `SchedulableSequence` 的薄包装，协议在本 crate、机制在 kvbm-logical。
570	- 调度按步渐进预约（预填只拿当前 chunk 的页，解码逐步补块），失败（如 `ScheduleError::AllocationFailed`）时不持有任何资源；`revert_schedule` 撤销一步，直接 drop 靠析构守卫归还——两阶段分离就是引擎的失败恢复能力。
571	- 视图的三条不变式：`seq_len` 取「步后」长度（decode 恒为 `kv_position + 1`）、`prefill_view` 覆盖目标长度、页表行必须精确覆盖 `seq_len`（多一页读垃圾、少一页越界，#291 的教训）；`step_page_indices` 专门裁掉积极分配多出的块。
572	- 提交族按场景分工：`apply_prefill`（带首 token 的最终 chunk）/ `apply_prefill_chunk`（中间 chunk）/ `apply_decode`（返回 `DecodeOutcome` 四变体）/ `apply_speculative`（只提交被接受前缀，LIFO 回收拒绝块）；`release` 让注册块进非活跃池供前缀缓存复用。
573	- 查询族四件套各数一件事：`kv_position`（已落账 KV）、`generated_tokens`（已产出，含悬空）、`is_complete`（达上限）、`resident_blocks`（物理持有，含积极分配，可超过落账需求——准入估算必须用它）。
574	
575	## 7. 下一步学习建议
576	
577	- **下一讲 u2-l3（KvView 与注意力内核的契约）**：本讲把 `KvView` 当黑盒用了，下一讲钻进 [src/view.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/view.rs)，看 `KvViewDesc` 如何把布局、物理缓冲指针与页表打包成内核元数据束，并亲手构造 17-token 的越界/缺页反例。
578	- 想看调度协议的真实消费者，去 `pegainfer-qwen3` 的调度器/executor 里搜 `schedule_prefill` / `decode_view` 的调用点，对照本讲的三拍子。
579	- 想先补全上下文可跳读 u2-l5（前缀缓存）：`release` 进非活跃池的块如何被 `match_and_add_prefix` 重新挂上，本讲 4.3 的「封块注册」正是那条链的起点。

# RequestKv：一个请求的 KV 生命周期

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u2-l1）我们认识了 `BlockPool`——它把物理页的发放、共享与回收管了起来，但一直没回答：**一个具体请求的 KV 到底是怎么一步步走完一生的？** 本讲就沿着 `RequestKv` 这条主线，把答案补全。学完后你应该能够：

1. 完整复述一个请求从 `new_request` 到 `release` 的 KV 状态变迁：预填（prefill）→ 解码（decode）循环 → 释放，以及投机解码（speculative）这条变体路径。
2. 解释 **schedule（调度）与 apply（应用）两阶段分离** 的设计：为什么「预约块」和「提交结果」必须是两个动作，以及它带来的失败恢复能力（`revert_schedule`、drop 守卫）。
3. 理解视图族的三条不变式：`decode_view` 的 `seq_len == kv_position + 1`、`prefill_view` 覆盖目标长度、页表行必须**精确覆盖**序列长度。
4. 熟练使用状态查询族（`kv_position` / `generated_tokens` / `is_complete` / `resident_blocks`）推断任意时刻的池容量变化。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲假设你已读过 u1-l3（页几何）与 u2-l1（BlockPool 与 padding 块）。在此之上，只需要再补三个推理引擎的常识：

- **预填（prefill）**：把 prompt 的所有 token 一次（或分块）喂进模型，计算出它们的 K/V 并写入缓存。这是「读题」阶段，计算量大但只做一次。
- **解码（decode）**：预填产出第一个生成 token 之后，每一步只把**一个**新 token 喂进模型，算出它的 K/V，再采样出下一个 token。这是「答题」阶段，一步一个 token。
- **悬空 token（dangling token）**：每次 forward 刚采样出来的那个 token，它的 K/V **还没有**被计算——它要等到下一步 forward 时才作为输入被算进缓存。`tests/lifecycle.rs` 的注释里有原话："token 42 is 'dangling' (not yet in KV)"。理解「悬空」是理解 `decode_view` 为什么是 `kv_position + 1` 的关键。
- **投机解码（speculative decode，选读）**：先让一个小模型连猜 `k` 个候选 token，再让大模型一次 forward 同时验证这 `k` 个位置，接受猜对的前缀。KV 层面表现为「一次预约多个位置的块，但只提交被接受的部分」。

另外回顾两个上一讲的结论，本讲会反复用到：

- 池构造时预留 1 块做 CUDA Graph 的 padding 槽，所以 `available_blocks() == total_blocks() - 1`。
- `BlockPool` 只发放**块 ID**，不持有显存；「拿了几块」完全可以从 `available_blocks()` 的变化观察出来——这正是本讲实践任务的观察窗口。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

先给一张总路线图。`RequestKv` 的结构体文档把生命周期写成了一行协议（原文见 [src/pool.rs:L373-L378](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L373-L378)）：

```
new_request
    │
    ▼
schedule_prefill(n) → prefill_view(n) → [forward] → apply_prefill / apply_prefill_chunk
    │                                                            │
    │            ←── 失败：revert_schedule 撤销预约，或直接 drop ──┘
    ▼
┌─ 解码循环（每轮一个 token）──────────────────────────────────────┐
│   schedule_decode → decode_view → [forward] → apply_decode      │
│   （或投机支线：schedule_speculative(k) → speculative_view(k)    │
│     → [forward] → apply_speculative(accepted)；失败 revert）     │
└──────────────────────────── is_complete() ──────────────────────┘
    │
    ▼
release()（或直接 drop）→ 块回到池
```

每个 forward 步骤内部都遵循同一个三拍子节奏：**预约（schedule）→ 给内核看视图（view）→ 提交（apply）**。下面四个小节依次拆解这三个拍子加一个「观察窗口」。

### 4.1 调度族：schedule_prefill / schedule_decode / schedule_speculative 与 ScheduleError

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

「调度」= **为这一步 forward 要写入的 KV 预约物理块**。它只动块、不动状态：预约成功后 `kv_position` 不变、没有任何 token 被认定已算完——计算要等 forward 真正跑完，由 apply 来承认。

为什么要单独一拍「预约」？因为块是稀缺资源，必须**先谈好再干活**：

- 准入判断需要它：池不够时这一步直接失败，GPU 白跑之前就能拒绝（测试 `exhaust_capacity_returns_error` 演示的正是这个）。
- 失败恢复需要它：forward 可能在预约之后、提交之前失败（CUDA 错误、请求被取消）。预约与提交分离后，「已预约未提交」是一个明确的状态，可以精确撤销（`revert_schedule`），甚至什么都不做、直接 drop 也能靠析构守卫把块还回去。

三个调度入口对应三种 forward 形状：

| 入口 | 一步写入的 KV | 典型预约量 |
|------|--------------|-----------|
| `schedule_prefill(num_tokens)` | 预填的一 chunk（可达上千 token） | \(\lceil \text{num\_tokens} / \text{block\_size} \rceil\) 块 |
| `schedule_decode` | 1 个 token（当前的悬空 token） | 通常 0 块（塞进现有块）；恰好填满最后一块时会**多**预约下一块 |
| `schedule_speculative(k)` | k 个连续位置（悬空 token + 候选草稿） | 覆盖这 k 个位置所需的块 |

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```
schedule_*(参数, pool):
    1. 检查请求状态机是否允许（必须处于 Idle/可调度态）
    2. 计算本步新增 KV 需要多少块
    3. 向 block_manager 申请块
       ├─ 成功：请求进入「已预约未提交」态，返回 Ok(())
       └─ 不够：返回 Err(ScheduleError::AllocationFailed { needed })
                  ——此时一块都没拿到，请求什么也不持有
```

失败分类由上游 `ScheduleError` 承载，共七种（见 4.1.3 的表）。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

三个调度方法本体极薄，全部转调上游（[src/pool.rs:L450-L473](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L450-L473)）：

```rust
pub fn schedule_prefill(
    &mut self,
    num_tokens: usize,
    pool: &BlockPool,
) -> Result<(), ScheduleError> {
    self.seq.schedule_prefill(num_tokens, &pool.block_manager)
}

pub fn schedule_decode(&mut self, pool: &BlockPool) -> Result<(), ScheduleError> {
    self.seq.schedule_decode(&pool.block_manager)
}

pub fn schedule_speculative(
    &mut self,
    num_draft_tokens: usize,
    pool: &BlockPool,
) -> Result<(), ScheduleError> {
    self.seq
        .schedule_speculative(num_draft_tokens, &pool.block_manager)
}
```

这段代码做的事：把「本步要写多少 token 的 KV」连同池的底层 `block_manager` 交给上游 `SchedulableSequence`，由它完成状态检查与块申请。注意三类调度的语义差别写在文档注释里——`schedule_speculative` 的注释明确「覆盖 `num_draft_tokens` 个连续位置（当前悬空 token + 候选草稿），失败用 `revert_schedule` 归还」。

失败类型全部定义在上游（[kvbm/kvbm-logical/src/integrations/scheduled.rs:L307-L331](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/kvbm/kvbm-logical/src/integrations/scheduled.rs#L307-L331)）：

| 变体 | 含义 |
|------|------|
| `NotIdle { state }` | 状态机不在可调度态（比如已经预约了一步还没 apply，又预约下一步） |
| `PrefillOverrun { .. }` | 这一步预填会越过 prompt 末尾（position + num_tokens > 输入长度） |
| `PrefillComplete` | 预填已完成，不允许再 schedule_prefill |
| `PrefillNotComplete { .. }` | 预填还没完成，不允许进入 decode |
| `AllocationFailed { needed }` | **池满**：需要 `needed` 块但空闲不足 |
| `GenerationComplete { .. }` | 生成已达上限，无事可调度 |
| `WrongDanglingCount { .. }` | 悬空 token 数与该步要求不符 |

容量耗尽的行为由集成测试钉死（[tests/lifecycle.rs:L144-L169](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L144-L169)）：4 块的池（可用 3），三个 16-token prompt 的请求各占 1 块后 `available_blocks() == 0`，第四个请求 `schedule_prefill(16)` 返回 `Err`；注意测试**从不 release 这个失败请求**，最后可用块数照样回到 3——说明失败的调度一块都没拿到、不持有任何资源，drop 它无需善后。

还有一个关键细节：**调度是按步渐进的，不是一次锁死整个请求的终身需求**。`multiple_requests_share_capacity`（[tests/lifecycle.rs:L52-L79](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L52-L79)）里请求 A 是「16-token prompt + 最多 16 个输出」，测试注释算出它终身需要 \(\lceil 31/16 \rceil = 2\) 块（16 个 prompt token + 15 个会真正算 KV 的生成 token；最后一个生成 token 完成请求即停，永远悬空、不需要 KV）。但 `schedule_prefill(16)` 此刻只拿走 1 块——第二块要等到解码阶段按需补充。这让多个请求能交错共享容量。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：对一个 40-token 的 prompt 调 `schedule_prefill(40, pool)`（`block_size = 16`），至少要预约几块？为什么？

答案：\(\lceil 40/16 \rceil = 3\) 块。预填一步要为这 40 个 token 的 KV 全部落位，页是最小分配单位，所以按页数向上取整。

**练习 2**：为什么 `new_request` 时不把请求终身需要的块一次性全部锁定？

答案：因为解码阶段的 KV 需求是逐步显现的（`schedule_decode` 按步拿块，甚至在 token 填满当前块的哪一步才多拿一块——见 4.2 的「积极分配」）。提前锁死会让长请求霸占大量暂时空置的块，`multiple_requests_share_capacity` 里 A、B 两个请求就无法共存了。渐进预约 = 更高并发。

**练习 3**：连续调用两次 `schedule_decode`（中间没有 apply）会发生什么？

答案：从 `ScheduleError` 的定义看应当返回 `NotIdle { state }`——上一步已预约未提交，状态机不在可调度态（[kvbm/kvbm-logical/src/integrations/scheduled.rs:L310-L311](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/kvbm/kvbm-logical/src/integrations/scheduled.rs#L310-L311)）。具体报错文本**待本地验证**（可在纯逻辑测试里断言 `matches!(err, ScheduleError::NotIdle { .. })`）。

### 4.2 视图族：prefill_view / decode_view / speculative_view

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

预约好了块，forward 之前还要回答注意力内核的两个问题：**这个请求的 KV 分布在哪几页？序列现在多长？** 这就是视图族的职责——把事务层（块、位置）翻译成内核只读的 `KvView`（三个字段：页表行、`seq_len`、`page_size`，见 [src/view.rs:L12-L16](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/view.rs#L12-L16)）。

两个不变式是这一族的灵魂：

1. **seq_len 是「本步之后」的长度**。视图描述的不是当前状态，而是「这一步 forward 写入完成后，内核将看到的 KV 全貌」。文档原话：*"The view's seq_len = kv_position + prompt_len (post-advance state that FlashInfer attention metadata expects)"*（[src/pool.rs:L480-L483](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L480-L483)）。于是：
   - `decode_view()`：\( \text{seq\_len} = \text{kv\_position} + 1 \)（现有 KV + 悬空 token 这一步将要写入的那条）；
   - `prefill_view(prompt_len)`：\( \text{seq\_len} = \text{kv\_position} + \text{prompt\_len} \)——**覆盖目标长度**，支持从非零位置续算的分块预填；
   - `speculative_view(k)`：\( \text{seq\_len} = \text{kv\_position} + k \)。
2. **页表行必须精确覆盖 seq_len**。内核按 \( \text{seq\_len} = (\text{num\_pages}-1) \times \text{page\_size} + \text{last\_page\_len} \) 反推长度：多给一页，内核会**多读一段序列之外的垃圾 K/V**；少给一页则越界（`KvView::new` 的断言注释原文引用了 issue #291，[src/view.rs:L19-L27](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/view.rs#L19-L27)）。

精确性之所以要专门 defended，是因为**原始块列表不可信**：kvbm 的 `schedule_decode` 有「积极分配」行为——当本步 token 恰好填满当前最后一块时，会顺手把下一块也分配了。于是 `page_indices()`（原始持有列表）可以比实际 KV 需要多一块。直接把原始列表给内核 = 让内核看到更长的序列 = 读垃圾页。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```
prefill_view(prompt_len):
    target = kv_position + prompt_len
    pages  = step_page_indices(prompt_len)   # 截断到 ceil(target / block_size)
    KvView::new(pages, target, block_size)   # 构造断言：pages.len() == ceil(target / block_size)

step_page_indices(new_tokens):
    assert new_tokens > 0
    kv_tokens = kv_position + new_tokens
    原始 page_indices() 截断到 ceil(kv_tokens / block_size) 页   # 丢弃积极多配的那块
```

`decode_view` / `speculative_view` 同构，只是 `new_tokens` 固定为 1 或 `k`。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

三个视图方法（[src/pool.rs:L477-L515](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L477-L515)）：

```rust
pub fn prefill_view(&self, prompt_len: usize) -> KvView {
    let target_seq_len = self.seq.kv_position() + prompt_len;
    KvView::new(
        self.step_page_indices(prompt_len),
        target_seq_len,
        self.seq.block_size(),
    )
}

pub fn decode_view(&self) -> KvView {
    KvView::new(
        self.step_page_indices(1),
        self.seq.kv_position() + 1,
        self.seq.block_size(),
    )
}
```

这段代码做的事：`seq_len` 一律取「当前 `kv_position` 加上本步新写入的 token 数」，页表行一律取 `step_page_indices`，绝不用原始块列表。

为什么绝不能用原始列表——`step_page_indices` 的文档注释讲得非常直白（[src/pool.rs:L618-L631](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L618-L631)）：

```rust
/// Page IDs covering exactly the KV tokens present after this step
/// appends `new_tokens` (`kv_position + new_tokens`). `page_indices()`
/// can hold one block more: kvbm's `schedule_decode` eagerly allocates
/// the next generation block whenever this step's token fills the last
/// slot of the current block. Page tables built from the raw list make
/// the kernel see a longer sequence than exists — use this for any
/// per-step page row handed to a forward pass.
pub fn step_page_indices(&self, new_tokens: usize) -> Vec<i32> {
    assert!(new_tokens > 0, "a forward step appends at least one token");
    let kv_tokens = self.seq.kv_position() + new_tokens;
    let mut pages = self.page_indices();
    pages.truncate(kv_tokens.div_ceil(self.seq.block_size()));
    pages
}
```

这段代码做的事：先按「现有 KV + 本步新增」算出目标 token 数，再把原始页表截断到 \(\lceil \text{kv\_tokens} / \text{block\_size} \rceil\) 页，把积极多配的块从内核视野里裁掉。

契约的最后防线在 `KvView::new` 的构造断言（[src/view.rs:L23-L34](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/view.rs#L23-L34)）：`assert_eq!(page_indices.len(), seq_len.div_ceil(page_size))`——页数对不上直接 panic，宁可崩溃也不让内核读错。配套的 `last_page_len`（[src/view.rs:L44-L51](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/view.rs#L44-L51)）有个容易踩的细节：`seq_len` 恰好整除 `page_size` 时最后一页是**满页**（返回 `page_size`），而不是 0。

两条不变式各有专门的测试钉住：

- `decode_view_seq_len_invariant`（[tests/lifecycle.rs:L194-L216](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L194-L216)）：解码循环里逐轮断言 `view.seq_len() == req.kv_position() + 1`。
- `prefill_view_covers_target_seq_len`（[tests/lifecycle.rs:L218-L235](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L218-L235)）：20-token 预填断言 `seq_len == 20`、`num_pages == 2`。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

### 4.3 提交族：apply_prefill / apply_prefill_chunk / apply_decode / apply_speculative、revert_schedule 与 release

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

forward 跑完、新 KV 已落在预约的页里，提交族负责让**事务层承认这次计算**，一次 apply 做三件事：

1. 把本步写满的块**封块注册**（注册过的块从此可被前缀缓存复用——上一讲「释放的注册块进 LRU 非活跃池」的伏笔在这里接上）；
2. 推进 `kv_position`；
3. 登记新采样的 token（它成为新的悬空 token），`generated_tokens` 加一。

提交族的五个成员各管一种收尾：

| 方法 | 场景 | 关键语义 |
|------|------|---------|
| `apply_prefill(token, pool)` | **最后一个**预填 chunk | 收下本步产出的第一个生成 token；此后进入解码态 |
| `apply_prefill_chunk(pool)` | 非最后的预填 chunk | 只封块、推进 `kv_position`，**不**产出 token（文档明确：最后一块必须走 `apply_prefill`） |
| `apply_decode(token, pool)` | 解码一步 | 返回 `DecodeOutcome`，告知块边界/长度上限是否到达 |
| `apply_speculative(accepted, pool)` | 投机验证步 | 只提交**被接受**的前缀，拒绝的草稿块按 LIFO 归还 |
| `release()` / `drop` | 请求终结 | 全部块归还：注册块进非活跃池（可复用），未注册块回空闲池 |

`DecodeOutcome` 是 `apply_decode` / `apply_speculative` 的返回值（[kvbm/kvbm-logical/src/integrations/scheduled.rs:L183-L188](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/kvbm/kvbm-logical/src/integrations/scheduled.rs#L183-L188)），四个变体可两两组合：

```rust
pub enum DecodeOutcome {
    Continue,
    BlockCompleted,
    MaxLength,
    BlockCompletedAndMaxLength,
}
```

从命名即可读出语义：「这一步是否恰好封满一块」（`BlockCompleted`，提示调度器该块已可复用）与「生成是否已达 `max_output_tokens`」（`MaxLength`，请求完成），两者同时发生就是第四个变体。

两阶段分离的**失败恢复面**由两个出口兜底：`revert_schedule` 主动撤销「已预约未提交」的一步（文档举例：投机的 forward 或 apply 失败时）；什么都不做直接 drop 则由 `SchedulableSequence` 的析构守卫归还——测试 `schedule_without_apply_returns_blocks_on_drop` 的注释就是这个行为的规格说明（*"dropping RequestKv must return those blocks to the pool"*，[tests/lifecycle.rs:L171-L192](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L171-L192)）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```
apply_prefill(token):
    校验状态 == 已调度的最终预填 chunk
    封块注册本 chunk 的页 → kv_position += chunk_len
    记录 token 为悬空 token，generated_tokens += 1     # 第一个生成 token

apply_decode(token):
    封块/推进 kv_position（把上一个悬空 token 的 KV 落账）
    记录新 token 为悬空 token，generated_tokens += 1
    返回 Continue | BlockCompleted | MaxLength | BlockCompletedAndMaxLength

apply_speculative(accepted_tokens):
    只保留 accepted 前缀对应的 KV；被拒草稿块 LIFO 归还
    generated_tokens += accepted.len()

失败出口 A：revert_schedule()   → 撤销本步预约，请求存活，可继续
失败出口 B：直接 drop            → 析构守卫归还本步预约的块
终结：     release()            → 归还全部块（注册块 → 非活跃池，可被前缀缓存命中）
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

提交族同样是一层薄委托（[src/pool.rs:L517-L564](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L517-L564)）：

```rust
pub fn apply_prefill(&mut self, token: u32, pool: &BlockPool) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    self.seq
        .apply_prefill(Some(token), &pool.block_manager)
        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("apply_prefill: {e}"))
}

/// Apply a non-final prefill chunk: registers the chunk's blocks and
/// advances `kv_position` without emitting a generated token. The final
/// chunk must go through [`Self::apply_prefill`] instead.
pub fn apply_prefill_chunk(&mut self, pool: &BlockPool) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    self.seq
        .apply_prefill(None, &pool.block_manager)
        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("apply_prefill_chunk: {e}"))
}

pub fn apply_decode(&mut self, token: u32, pool: &BlockPool) -> anyhow::Result<DecodeOutcome> {
    self.seq
        .apply_decode(token, &pool.block_manager)
        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("apply_decode: {e}"))
}
```

这段代码做的事：`apply_prefill` 与 `apply_prefill_chunk` 其实是上游同一个方法 `apply_prefill(Some/None)` 的两个外壳——`Some(token)` 表示这是产出首 token 的最终 chunk，`None` 表示中间 chunk。投机提交与回退（[src/pool.rs:L540-L558](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L540-L558)）的文档注释把分工写得很清楚：*"kvbm keeps the `accepted_tokens` KV and LIFO-releases the rejected draft blocks"*；`revert_schedule` 则 *"Undo a scheduled-but-unapplied KV reservation … and return its blocks to the pool"*。

drop 守卫的完整规格（[tests/lifecycle.rs:L171-L192](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L171-L192)）：

```rust
/// Schedule allocates blocks, but if we never apply (e.g. forward
/// failed), dropping RequestKv must return those blocks to the pool.
#[test]
fn schedule_without_apply_returns_blocks_on_drop() {
    let mgr = make_manager(10); // 9 usable
    let before = mgr.pool().available_blocks();

    {
        let mut req = mgr.pool().new_request(vec![1; 32], 1, None);
        // 32 tokens → ceil(32/16) = 2 blocks scheduled
        req.schedule_prefill(32, mgr.pool())
            .expect("schedule_prefill");
        assert!(mgr.pool().available_blocks() < before);
        // No apply_prefill — simulate forward failure. Drop req here.
    }

    assert_eq!(
        mgr.pool().available_blocks(),
        before,
        "blocks must return on drop"
    );
}
```

这段测试做的事：32-token 预填预约 2 块（可用 9 → 7），在内层作用域结束时**故意不 apply 就 drop**，出作用域后可用块数必须回到 9。引擎由此获得一条免费的安全网：forward 崩了、请求被取消、上层代码 panic 展开——只要 `RequestKv` 被析构，块就不会泄漏。

端到端全流程的黄金样例是 `single_request_prefill_decode_release`（[tests/lifecycle.rs:L10-L50](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/tests/lifecycle.rs#L10-L50)），它把 4.1-4.4 四族 API 按协议顺序各用一遍，综合实践一节会逐行排演它。

答案：`revert_schedule` 只撤销**当前这一步已预约未提交**的预约，请求继续存活、状态回到可再次调度（用于一步失败后的重试）；`release` 终结整个请求，归还其**全部**块——其中注册过的块进入非活跃池成为前缀缓存的一部分，而非简单回空闲池（[src/pool.rs:L552-L564](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L552-L564)，非活跃池语义见 u2-l1）。

答案：投机一步预约的是覆盖 k 个连续位置的一串块，验证后只有被接受前缀的 KV 要保留。被拒部分集中在预约串的**尾部**，后进先出的归还顺序恰好对应「从尾部往回收」，使保留前缀与已注册块的边界保持一致，避免误放仍被接受的块（文档注释：*"kvbm keeps the `accepted_tokens` KV and LIFO-releases the rejected draft blocks"*，[src/pool.rs:L540-L550](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L540-L550)；完整语义在上游 kvbm，**深入实现待确认**）。

### 4.4 状态查询族：kv_position / generated_tokens / is_complete / resident_blocks

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

调度器每一步都要「看一眼」请求才能决策，查询族就是这扇观察窗。四个量各数一件事，**初学者最容易混的是前三个**：

| 查询 | 数的是什么 | 单调性 |
|------|-----------|--------|
| `kv_position()` | K/V **已算完落账**的 token 数（悬空 token 不算） | 只增 |
| `generated_tokens()` | 已产出的生成 token 数（含悬空的那颗） | 只增 |
| `is_complete()` | 生成是否已达 `max_output_tokens` | 一旦真不再变 |
| `resident_blocks()` | 此刻**物理上**持有的块数（注册 + 已 stage + 未指派） | 可升可降（apply/revert/释放） |

`kv_position` 与 `generated_tokens` 永远差 1（预填完成后）：产出的最新 token 悬空着，等下一步才算 KV。这就是「视图 = `kv_position` + 1」的代数根源。

`resident_blocks` 是四个里唯一**可以暂时超过** \(\lceil \text{kv\_position} / \text{block\_size} \rceil\) 的量——因为积极分配的块、预约未提交的块都真实占着物理页。文档原话：*"Physical blocks currently held by this request, including registered, staged, and eagerly allocated dangling blocks"*（[src/pool.rs:L592-L596](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L592-L596)）。调度器做准入时必须用它（而非 `kv_position` 推算），否则会低估占用。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```
任意时刻：
    kv_position       = 已封块/已落账的 KV token 数
    generated_tokens  = kv_position - prompt_len + 1        （预填完成后）
    is_complete()     ⇔ generated_tokens ≥ max_output_tokens
    resident_blocks   = assigned + staged + unassigned      ≥ ceil(kv_position / block_size)

available_blocks()    = 池总块数 - 1(padding) - Σ各请求 resident_blocks（近似，忽略非活跃池回收的细节）
```

（最后一个式子是理解综合实践里容量排演的钥匙：**观察一个请求的占用，就看 `available_blocks` 掉了多少**。）

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

查询族一览（[src/pool.rs:L577-L596](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L577-L596)）：

```rust
/// Tokens with KV already computed.
pub fn kv_position(&self) -> usize {
    self.seq.kv_position()
}

pub fn generated_tokens(&self) -> usize {
    self.seq.generated_tokens()
}

/// Physical blocks currently held by this request, including registered,
/// staged, and eagerly allocated dangling blocks.
pub fn resident_blocks(&self) -> usize {
    self.seq.assigned_blocks() + self.seq.staged_blocks() + self.seq.unassigned_blocks()
}
```

这段代码做的事：三个计数直接读上游序列；`resident_blocks` 明确把三类持有（已注册 / 已 stage / 未指派）加总——其中「未指派」就包含积极分配出的下一块。

与视图族衔接的两个页表查询也值得认识（[src/pool.rs:L598-L631](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-cache/src/pool.rs#L598-L631)）：`page_indices()` 是**原始**持有列表（可以多一块，私有方法）；`current_page_indices()` 把它截断到当前 `kv_position` 需要的页数，供 offload 等模块做「现在已落账的页」的快照；`step_page_indices(n)` 是 forward 用的精确页表行（4.2 已精读）。三者同名异义，正是「原始 vs 落账 vs 本步」三个视角的代码化。

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
